headline: Malaysian Palm Oil Drops 1.2% on Cheaper Rival Oils and Crude
summary: Benchmark palm oil futures for February delivery fell 1.22% to 4,382 ringgit ($1,071.39) per metric ton on the Bursa Malaysia Derivatives Exchange, pressured by declining rival oils and weak crude.
why: Palm oil is the world's most consumed edible oil and a major export for Malaysia and Indonesia, with prices closely correlated to competing soyoil and petroleum.

impacts.name: Palm Oil Futures
impacts.why: Palm oil futures declined 1.22% tracking losses in competing edible oils and crude benchmarks.
